name: limit_hole_wizard_outside_the_part
why: ENTRY Z-C21.2, finding L4-3. IFeature~ModifyDefinition.html, Remarks: the method can answer true and leave «a new rebuild error on the feature. [...] After calling this method, call IFeature::GetErrorCode2». hole_wizard looked only at the bool, and read the volume only with the anchors: a hole in error had no cylinders to find, the verdict on the positions said «cannot be verified», and the operation answered succeeded with «positions_not_checked».
defect_caught: The rebuild error forced in the simplest way: the only position of the hole is at x = 500 on a plate that runs from -100 to 100. The hole is born (HoleWizard5 puts it on the chosen face), then the point moves out of the material and the hole rebuilds in error or removes nothing. On the old library: succeeded, «positions_not_checked». On the new one: refusal, and the hole is removed (volume and tree as before).
_what_is_not_measured: Whether SOLIDWORKS gives an error code or only a warning for a hole outside the part is not measured: that is why the new guard looks FIRST at GetErrorCode2 and THEN at the volume, and the message the case demands is the part common to the two refusals («did not come out»).
_the_twin: `hole_wizard_follows_the_table`: the same threaded through M8 on the same face, with the position inside the plate. It differs by «positions».

message_includes: The wizard hole did not come out
